recipe.visualDefinition: A four-panel grid composition featuring individual portraits of anthropomorphic clay figures. The style utilizes dramatic, high-contrast studio lighting against a black background, mimicking classic rock album photography. The top section contains a white header with bold, multi-colored sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Four equal quadrants separated by thin white grid lines
Consistent high-key side lighting across all four portraits
Text-heavy header contrasting with dark, minimalist imagery below
Organic, wrinkled textures of the clay figures against flat black voids
coreInvariants: Anthropomorphic characters with distinct facial expressions

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four centered busts, one in each quadrant, filling approximately 70% of their respective frames.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold primary title in the top right of the header.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left blue text, moves right to the large red title, then scans the four portraits in a Z-pattern.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant black negative space surrounding each character to emphasize their form and texture.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan and Red (typography and character accessories)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white header and black panels; moderate saturation in the characters' clay textures.

letterConstructionRules: Squat, wide proportions for the primary title
Standard geometric sans-serif for the subtitle
characterSpecificRedesigns: Exclamation point integrated into the baseline of the primary title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Scale and color contrast between a heavy display face and a functional subtitle face.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal and vertical rules forming a grid

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and classic American feel of the primary title.
Provides a clean, neutral look for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 2x2 grid of four distinct claymation-style characters. Each character should be a wrinkled, purple-brown anthropomorphic figure with expressive eyes and mouth. Use harsh side-lighting against a pure black background for each panel. Place the grid on a white canvas with a large white margin at the top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold, red sans-serif title in the top right of the white margin. Add a smaller cyan sans-serif title to the left of it. Place a single line of black descriptive text horizontally across the bottom of the white margin, just above the grid.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting consistent across all four panels?
Is the text in the header bold and legible?
Are the clay textures visible and detailed?

adjustableVariables: Specific colors of the header text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white grid lines are thin and sharp.
Verify the characters look like physical clay models, not digital renders.
Check that the header text does not overlap the image panels.
Confirm the color palette is limited to the specified roles.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a 2x2 grid of high-contrast, dark-background character portraits with a clean, white-header typographic layout using bold sans-serif fonts.
